description: Vestments of the Oracle Level 60 Bring the the Husk of the Old God, 2 Idols of Death, 5 Stone Scarabs and 5 Crystal Scarabs to Vethsera inside Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Honored reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest. Requirements: - Husk of the Old God - Idol of Death x 2 - Stone Scarab x 5 - Crystal Scarab x 5 - Brood of Nozdormu:
name: Vestments of the Oracle
